description: This file defines the MenuSessionsInjector class responsible for managing and dynamically injecting session-related menu items into a macOS status menu. It handles loading session data, caching, UI updates, and user interactions such as resetting or deleting sessions, as well as showing usage and cost summaries. It also manages observing control channel state changes and supports testing configurations.

classes.name: MenuSessionsInjector
classes.description: A class responsible for injecting and managing session-related menu items in a macOS status menu, including handling cache, observing control channel, and user interactions.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Sets up the injector into a specific NSStatusItem, assigns delegate, and starts cache refresh and control channel observation.

methods.name: menuWillOpen
methods.description: Handles logic when the menu is opening, including caching and injecting session items, and starting background refresh tasks.

methods.name: menuDidClose
methods.description: Handles cleanup when the menu is closed, cancelling ongoing tasks.

methods.name: menuNeedsUpdate
methods.description: To be called when the menu requires an update, delegates to the original delegate.

methods.name: confinementRect
methods.description: Returns the possibly overridden confinement rectangle for the menu.

methods.name: inject
methods.description: Main function to inject session-related items into the menu, including session list, usage, and cost summaries.

methods.name: injectNodes
methods.description: Injects node information items into the menu.

methods.name: refreshCache
methods.description: Asynchronously refreshes the session snapshot cache.

methods.name: refreshUsageCache
methods.description: Asynchronously refreshes the usage summary cache.

methods.name: refreshCostUsageCache
methods.description: Asynchronously refreshes the cost usage summary cache.

methods.name: buildSubmenu
methods.description: Builds a submenu for a session row with previews, thinking, verbose, and control actions.

methods.name: buildThinkingMenu
methods.description: Constructs a menu for selecting the session's thinking level.

methods.name: buildVerboseMenu
methods.description: Constructs a menu for toggling verbose output.

methods.name: buildPreviewSubmenu
methods.description: Builds a preview submenu for recent messages.

methods.name: buildNodesOverflowMenu
methods.description: Builds a menu for additional nodes beyond a limit.

methods.name: buildNodeSubmenu
methods.description: Builds a submenu with detailed node information.

methods.name: makeNodeItem
methods.description: Creates a menu item representing a node.

methods.name: makeSessionPreviewItem
methods.description: Creates a menu item for session message preview.

methods.name: buildCostUsageSubmenu
methods.description: Builds a submenu with cost usage visualization or error message.

methods.name: gatewayEntry
methods.description: Generates a NodeInfo object representing the gateway.

methods.name: makeNodeCopyItem
methods.description: Creates a menu item to copy node property.

methods.name: makeNodeDetailItem
methods.description: Creates a menu item showing node property detail.

methods.name: formatVersionLabel
methods.description: Formats version strings with a 'v' prefix if needed.

methods.name: patchThinking
methods.description: Handles user action to patch the session thinking level.

methods.name: patchVerbose
methods.description: Handles user action to toggle verbose mode.

methods.name: openSessionLog
methods.description: Open session log in an external viewer.

methods.name: resetSession
methods.description: Reset a specific session.

methods.name: compactSession
methods.description: Compress and archive a session log.

methods.name: deleteSession
methods.description: Delete a session.

methods.name: copyNodeSummary
methods.description: Copies node summary to clipboard.

methods.name: copyNodeValue
methods.description: Copies specific node property value to clipboard.
